pins.description: Wrong vs right, side by side. Light Spring wardrobe base: Warm White, Light Camel and Warm Taupe. Add accents in Peach, Warm Pink and Light Coral. Jewelry: light gold, rose gold, warm-toned pearls, amber, peridot, aquamarine. Avoid Black, Dark Navy and Burgundy near your face. Find your wardrobe colors with a free AI personal color analysis from one selfie.

pins.headline: 4 Frames for Heart Faces
pins.title: 4 Frames for Heart Faces | Glasses Frame Guide by Face Shape
pins.description: Save this cheat sheet. Best frames for a heart face: bottom-heavy frames; round or oval frames; light-colored or rimless bottom frames. Skip top-heavy or decorative frames; cat-eye frames. Find your face shape and best frames with a free AI face shape analysis.

pins.headline: The Soft Summer Color Secret Nobody Tells You
pins.title: The Soft Summer Color Secret Nobody Tells You | Seasonal Color Analysis Palette
pins.description: The detail most guides skip. Soft Summer looks best in Sage Green, Dusty Rose, Soft Mauve, Muted Teal and Dusty Blue. Skip Bright Red, Electric Blue and Neon Yellow, which can wash out Soft Summer coloring. Find your own season in about 60 seconds with a free AI personal color analysis from one selfie.
